description: Returns the contract storage for the specified range.

parameters.name: blockReference
parameters.description: The block hash in string format or block number as hexadecimal in the object format

parameters.name: txIndex
parameters.description: The transaction index for the point in which we want the list of accounts

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of storage entries to return

storage.description: An object with hash values, and for each of them the key and value it represents

storage.hash.key.description: The key associated with the hash

storage.hash.value.description: The value associated with the hash

nextKey.description: The hash of next key if further storage in range. Otherwise, not included
